item.title: Russell Brand's Friend on the TRUTH, Meghan Markle's Father Back in Jail, and Diversity Over Excellence in Culture, with Heather Mac Donald | Ep. 1439 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by comedian Samantha Pressdee to discuss her longtime friendship with Russell Brand, the false campaign against him, how the idea that Brand being a criminal was an "open secret" is a lie, the truth about how the campaign against Russell Brand started, how he changed his politics and fought the system and then the system came after him, Charlie Kirk's comments about Brand the month before he died, and more. Then Megyn dives into the corporate media focusing on the "monkey" Ole Miss female students incident, how the media is blowing up the story to try to push a racism narrative, what we know about what actually happened and what we still don't, the new details we're learning about the Alina Habba $50 million grift, the sketchy details of her marriage to a young billionaire, how she could be heading to a Congressional hearing very soon, Meghan Markle’s father Thomas Markle cutting off his ankle monitor, how he was sent back to jail without bond, a congresswoman floating the idea of the death penalty over his crimes, and more. Then Heather Mac Donald, fellow at the Manhattan Institute, joins to discuss the narcissism of the leadership class in the arts, an orchestra firing a conductor for pushing “artistic excellence” over diversity, the push by some to stop playing music from white men, and more.

 

 

Pressdee- https://x.com/SammiePressdee

Mac Donald- https://x.com/hmdatmi
